summary: Server backup of a character's level-up / respec choices kept while esv::character_creation::ChangeAppearanceSubsystem runs (macOS: its Update and Abort write the component) so they can be restored. Its shape is exactly the tail of a full respec definition - the same members as SE ecl::character_creation::FullRespecDefinitionComponent (Components/CharacterCreation.h): class Guid, subclass Guid, an int, LevelUpUpgrades (7 selector arrays) and an Array<SpellMetaId>. Created by bg3.exe+0x37B01A0 (AllocRaw 0xA8); destructor bg3.exe+0x6AB900. Saved: model game.character_creation.v2.BackupDefinitionComponent (8 bytes - a reference) written with the v2 selector models (AbilityBonusSelector, AbilitySelector, EquipmentSelector, LevelUpComponentSelectors, PassiveSelector, SkillExpertiseSelector, SkillSelector, SpellSelector) and DiffDefinition. Never seen alive. Registry total 168 (server row).

Creator zeroes +0x28..+0x97 in seven Array patterns.
